medium: FACTUAL_PROFESSION_ERROR — LeakTraceGame.tsx retains a previously heard non-silent record after its segment is closed, as designed, but the associated house-window blink and latest-reading waveform also continue animating. Those animations look like live sound despite the segment being isolated, contradicting the closed-segment silent rule. This is an implementation-only visual-state defect, not a §3 RELEASE BLOCKER-class defect, and is outside hd-2 scope.
low: DOCUMENTATION_STALE — no_manual_exploit_check_v9.json still quotes obsolete v5 rates in several fields: random report 9.8% instead of 10.7%, flow-only 34.7% instead of 32.5%, valves-ignored 25.0% instead of 23.0%, and forgets-reopen 46.0% instead of 33.2%. Its later report_grounding field has the correct v9 figures. This is a polish item outside hd-2 scope.

failure_codes.finding: After an intermittent non-silent reading is heard, closing that segment preserves lastReading; the window blink condition does not check v.closed, and the latest-reading waveform remains rendered. The UI can therefore continue visibly presenting active sound on a closed, silent segment. Implementation-only; not §3 RELEASE BLOCKER-class.

sim_verification.own_adversarial_strategy: State-transition attack covering pre-miss listens, records-only, silent listen, explicit/implicit reopen cycling, and silent-point drop/re-listen: every prohibited second-report path has 0% success because a miss sets unlocked=false and the only subsequent transition assigning true is a non-silent listen. Reopening and record removal never alter unlocked; re-listening a dropped silent point unlocks only when it produces a new non-silent reading, which satisfies Gate G.
sim_verification.notes: The direct run reached result generation but could not overwrite design-sim-result.json because the review sandbox is read-only. The same source was then evaluated with only its final write redirected to stdout. It reproduced the committed results exactly: legitimate 600/600; solvability 306/306; worst 4 listens and 2 valve operations; rates 10.7%, 26.2%, 26.2%, 32.5%, 23.0%, and 33.2%; all eight flags true; all four gate counters 200/200. gameplay-qa-leak.mjs independently passed 50/50.
